title: 18 Years Ago, A Controversial Nickelodeon Sequel Ended
content: Nickelodeon has had no problem returning to the well for some of its biggest animated properties since the NickToons first arrived decades prior. Various series saw comebacks with original movies that would air years, if not decades, after their series ended.
author: ComicBook

title: Ayumu Murase Steps Down From Kanon Himeno Role in The Idolmaster SideM
content: Bandai Namco 's Idolm@ster franchise announced on Tuesday that Ayumu Murase will "graduate" from the role of Kanon Himeno in The Idolmaster SideM franchise, no longer voicing the character. The company announced a new cast member will join Kanon's Mofumofuen unit at a later date.
author: ANN

title: Manga Mavericks Books Appoints Erica Friedman as Managing Editor
content: The company states that Friedman will help for its upcoming year, during which it plans to release over 40 alternative, shojo , josei , LGBTQ+, and classic manga. In addition to writing for ANN, Friedman has published articles and reports about yuri for Eureka, Animerica , the Comic Book Legal Defense Fund, Dark Horse…
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Store Removes Physical Manga, Light Novels
content: Crunchyroll announced in July that it would change its Crunchyroll Store in August to be exclusive to the company's Mega and Ultimate Fan subscription tiers. The updated store features "curated drops and Crunchyroll ‑exclusive merch" as well as select collectibles, Blu-ray Discs, and apparel.
author: ANN

title: Paramount in Talks to Revive Classic NickToon Series
content: Over the decades, Nickelodeon has made a name for itself in the cable network sphere by producing original animated series that have withstood the test of time. One of the biggest examples has been SpongeBob SquarePants , which has continued to release new episodes for decades following its premiere.
author: ComicBook

title: Special Effects Artist, The Guyver Director Screaming Mad George Dies at 69
content: The official X/Twitter account for the manager of special effects artist and musician Screaming Mad George (Jōji Tani) announced on Monday that Screaming Mad George died on February 10 earlier this year. He was 69. He is survived by his wife Miki and daughter Alice.
author: ANN

title: Detective Conan Creator Teases Series Finale
content: While anime franchises such as Dragon Ball and One Piece have found serious success in the West, there are some long-running anime properties that don’t hit the same heights as the Straw Hat Pirates and the Z-Fighters.
author: ComicBook

title: cocoon Wartime Anime Streams English-Dubbed Trailer
content: GKIDS began streaming on Tuesday an English-dubbed trailer for cocoon – One Summer of Girlhood ( cocoon Aru Natsu no Shōjo-tachi Yori ), the anime of Machiko Kyō 's Cocoon manga. This year's JAPAN CUTS event screened the anime's North American premiere on July 10.
author: ANN

title: Cells at Work! Gets Kabuki Stage Play in April 2027
content: A new official X/Twitter account opened last Friday to announce that Akane Shimizu 's Cells at Work! ( Hataraku Saibō ) manga is getting a kabuki stage play adaptation at the Shinbashi Enbujō in Tokyo in April 2027.
author: ANN

title: Kingdom Hearts 'Anime' Announced for Disney+, Kingdom Hearts IV Game Launches in Late 2027 Including Coco World
content: The D23 event's "Disney Entertainment Showcase" panel announced on Friday that an "anime" with the working title Kingdom Hearts based on Square Enix 's game franchise is in development for release on Disney+ and The Disney Channel . The event did not reveal what studio is producing the series.
author: ANN
